Please submit your paper via the following link: https://gsm-academic.mikecrm.com/tzBNVRk

Important Dates
• Paper submission deadline: November 1, 2026, 23:59 (Beijing time)
• Notification of selection: Around November 10, 2026
• Release of presentation schedule: Late November 2026

Accommodation Support
To encourage high-quality academic exchange, the conference offers selected presenters with two nights of accommodation at a designated hotel.
Job market interviews will be arranged directly between candidates and recruiting institutions, rather than centrally by the conference organizers.
In-person audience members are welcome to attend the Academic Presentation Session. Candidates whose papers are not selected for presentation are warmly encouraged to register and attend as audience members.

For inquiries regarding paper submissions or other conference arrangements, please contact us at: cqf@gsm.pku.edu.cn
